name: settlement-lockon
description: I-0114 tranche 3 (UNLOCK-READY §5, the camera with a target; the first final review's M5): Beta at the Undead Settlement bonfire (m31, the settlement path's save; with test-no-ai.flag the hollows stand still): the walk out of the shelter into the street (Z 3 s), lock-on (the middle button), a strafe right and left around the target (D, Q 1.5 s), a target switch (one mouse move right while locked), a strafe right and a strafe left, once (series 25: the middle click that released the lock lost the window's foreground in both runs, so the lock stays on to the end). Read with locomotion-observe.flag and mechanics-observe.flag (the follow camera's yaw and the player's position every 1/30 s of the logic's time). Times in ms from the motion start; each segment's events in time order.
